data.name: Wild Step
data.description: A Green Faith marshal can move through any sort of naturally occurring difficult terrain (such as natural thorns, briars, overgrown areas, and similar terrain) at her normal speed without taking damage or suffering any other impairment. Terrain that is enchanted or magically manipulated to impede motion, however, still affects her.
